messages:
alex: Hey @eng-runtime — ping for quick eyes on PR #8123. This changes prefetch/prefill heuristics for longseq. Canary passed functional tests but quick microbench smoke shows p95 latency up ~8% and mem p95 up ~120MB on 4k seq. CI artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/arch/8123/ (perf artifacts attached). Can we get a quick ack or a hold? cc @maria @devon :eyes:

maria: grabbing artifacts now. can you paste the exact bench command you ran?

devon: I pulled the artifact briefly — looks like extra mem may be from the prefetch buffer not being released. Can you paste the small config diff?

alex: bench command I used: `./bench --model=gpt-large --seq=4096 --batch=1 --iters=50 --metric=p95`
Attached tail of perf log:
```
p95 latency: base=240ms -> pr=260ms (+8.3%)
mem p95: base=6.8GB -> pr=6.92GB (+120MB)
```
PR link: https://git.internal.redwood/pr/8123
Config diff snippet: 
```diff
+prefetch_window=256
+retain_prefetch=true
```
CI: canary link posted too.

ci-bot: canary run finished: all tests passed. perf artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/arch/8123/perf

samir: two quick thoughts — 1) try prefetch_window=128 to see memory impact; 2) is KV cache sharing affected? any shard/packing changes in this PR?

maria: if the mem bump reproduces across runs we should hold merge and try the 128 experiment. can we get a quick microbench run by 11:30 PT?

alex: will run 128 now and post numbers in ~10m.

(10m)
alex: quick follow-up results for prefetch_window=128:
```
p95 latency: base=240ms -> pr=263ms (+9.6%)
mem p95: base=6.8GB -> pr=6.85GB (+50MB)
```
So memory comes down ~70MB vs 256 window but latency worsens slightly.

devon: thanks — that aligns with prefetch doing more work when window smaller. seems like a latency/memory tradeoff. any chance retain_prefetch=true is keeping buffers across requests?

alex: looking at code, retain_prefetch toggles whether the buffer survives slot eviction. I can flip to false and re-run.

maria: proposal: block merge unless we either (A) revert retain_prefetch=true and ship prefetch_window=256 as a follow-up, or (B) keep retain_prefetch and add adaptive backoff to avoid retention for rare large sequences. Either needs a follow-up ticket.
samir: +1 to holding and opening a follow-up. adaptive backoff sounds more involved.

alex: OK I'll revert retain_prefetch in this PR and open a follow-up for adaptive retention/backoff with a benchmark plan. Re-run attaching results in a sec.

(later)
alex: reverted retain_prefetch and re-ran the same bench:
```
p95 latency: base=240ms -> pr=242ms (+0.8%)
mem p95: base=6.8GB -> pr=6.81GB (+10MB)
```
Looks acceptable. I updated PR description with the follow-up ticket: https://git.internal.redwood/tickets/1456 (adaptive-prefetch-backoff).

maria: thanks. requesting one more perf LGTM from @devon then we can merge. please add the follow-up ticket to the PR body.
devon: skimmed the changes, bench numbers look fine after revert. LGTM for perf contingent on follow-up ticket and test plan in the ticket. :thumbsup:

alex: thx all — merging after CI green. will monitor canary tail for the next 6 hours. :rocket:
